name: Werner H. Kirsten Student Internship Program (WHK SIP)

offerings.cycle_label: Annual cycle - applied for in junior year
offerings.summary: A year-long cancer research internship at NCI-Frederick: eight full-time weeks in the summer after junior year, then part-time work through senior year.

grades.raw: Be in their junior year of high school when applying.

age.raw: Student must be 17 years old by the first day of the internship.

citizenship.raw: be sixteen years of age or older, and a U.S. citizen or resident alien

gpa.raw: Have an overall un-weighted grade point average of 3.0 or greater.

offerings.prereq: Have taken or planning to take both a science and mathematics course their junior year or have the equivalent of three math/science years of credits. Have valid health insurance. Have been absent from high school 10 days or less during their sophomore year.

fee.raw: There is no fee or charge for participation in the WHK SIP

comp.raw: summer paid at approximately $3600; students will not be compensated for their service during the school year

sched.dur_raw: Eight consecutive weeks during summer (8.5 hours/day); minimum three hours daily during senior year

issues: The application page read does not publish an open date or deadline; the current-cycle window must be confirmed before publication
No cycle year is stated on the page read
